description: The file defines the AppSetupUtility class which provides methods for setting up, configuring, migrating, and managing the database and configuration states during the installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionalities like creating databases, inserting system configs, running migrations, handling database users, and generating configuration files.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for database setup, migration execution, configuration management, and installation process control in OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the ConfigHelper instance used for configuration operations.

methods.name: getSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the SystemConfiguration instance used for system configuration tasks.

methods.name: getMigrationHelper
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the MigrationHelper instance used for logging and processing migration steps.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema with the specified name on the database server.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the given name exists on the server.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific database user exists in the MySQL user table.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the connected database is empty (no tables).

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates or verifies the creation of the database ensuring it is ready for installation.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts initial system configuration values into the database, like CSRF key, organization info, default language, and admin user data.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database users and grants permissions based on the installation settings.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes the configuration file with database connection details by replacing placeholders in a template.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Generates and writes a cryptographic key file for security purposes.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of migration versions in a specified range for processing.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Executes migration scripts in order from a starting version to an optional ending version.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Runs the migration script corresponding to a specific version.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the current application version stored in the database and matches it with known migration classes.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables in the database to clean up in case of a failed installation.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops the entire database specified in the current session.
